'''Uhltenden''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TCSWE" /> located within the [[Thrasybule sector/Legends|Thrasybule sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Surrounded by a debris ring from many wrecked starships, the planet had an atmosphere toxic to life, and no natural life resided on the planet.<ref name="TCSWE" />

==History==
During the [[Bounty Hunter Wars]], [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] captured [[Ob Fortuna]] above Uhltenden.<ref name="SS" />

*''[[Slave Ship]]'' {{1st}} {{Flash}}
